test_title: PYST 49: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question:
The given pie-chart shows the distribution of the marks scored by Ram in five different subjects (in percentage).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dd9e41a288280762625a371f3c29309b3d214ad31e55f64f9ecc668d006ca55.png] 

What is the ratio of the central angle of Maths to the central angle of Science?
solution:
**Calculation : **

⇒ 360° = 100%

⇒ 1% = 3.6° 

Central angle for maths = 20 × 3.6° = 72° 

Central angle for science = 30 × 3.6° = 108° 

Ratio = 72 : 108 = 2 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 3.**
